name: Flat API
description: The Flat API allows you to easily extend the abilities of the Flat Platform, with a wide range of use cases including the following: Creating and importing new music scores using MusicXML, MIDI, Guitar Pro, MuseScore, ABC notation, and many other formats Browsing, updating, copying, exporting the user's scores (for example in MP3, WAV or MIDI) Managing educational resources with Flat for Education: creating & updating the organization accounts, the classes, rosters and assign
